checks.title: Confirm replenishment outcome and owner
checks.instructions: Name the merchant, procurement decision owner, budget authority, supplier contact owner, destination location and first case.

checks.title: Bind exact item and location
checks.instructions: Record store, market, product, variant, InventoryItem, Location, case ID and time zone. Confirm the inventory source authority.

checks.title: Agree demand and stock calculation
checks.instructions: Set the demand window, unit definition, available versus incoming treatment, backorders, review interval and safety stock. Do not subtract committed units twice.

checks.title: Verify current supplier terms
checks.instructions: Confirm supplier ID/SKU, lead time, MOQ, case pack, unit cost/currency, open PO, delivery destination, and budget approval policy from current sources.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Catalog & Merchandising Analyst and Replenishment Planner IDs, skills, setup status and authorized access.

checks.title: Probe representative sources
checks.instructions: Read one InventoryLevel, a same-item/location demand extract, supplier terms and current incoming/open PO/transfer records. Record exact IDs, dates, coverage and gaps.

checks.title: Recompute and validate handoff
checks.instructions: Run the bundled validator; reject wrong item/location, double-counted commitments, stale terms, incorrect ceiling/pack rounding, cost mismatch and premature ordered/received state.

checks.title: Review proposed purchasing route
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, evidence paths, formula and currency, owner, budget, approval, optional PO action, transfer verification, cost and manual route before Builder applies it.

checks.title: Run one real case manually
checks.instructions: Recompute one authorized item/location proposal and one missing-data or open-PO duplicate case; retain validator results and procurement owner review. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose recurrence and action boundary
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or an authenticated deduplicated review trigger with owner, cost and notification policy. PO and transfer writes remain separately approved and tested.
